paths.text:
How players level through the world:

- Every player starts at the Abbey, in the starting zone.
- Right after the starting zone there's a choice, and one choice sends you to the other continent.
- The leveling paths interweave, and zones don't have matching level ranges.
- Neither continent covers the whole leveling journey: each has gaps.
- Quests haul you back and forth between the continents.
